description: A periodic volume.density grid with the CHGCAR-style point count (voxel_vectors[a] x shape[a] is the 4 Å cell) that declares includes_endpoint true, under which voxel_vectors[a] x (shape[a] - 1) must span the cell: the silent cube/CHGCAR mix-up the endpoint rule exists to catch (spec § 5.2).
